status: Decided by the owner in conversation on 2026-10-31; not yet loaded. Load with manage.py load_access_overrides (dry run, then --confirm after the owner confirms this file), then rebuild.
annotations: Northern Virginia, 32 ways (about 16 mi), from the Virginia ratings recheck (thread "Recheck Virginia road ratings"). P4 at LTS 3.5: 8 ways (5.2 mi); P4 at LTS 4: 18 ways (5.4 mi); P8 at LTS 2.5: 5 ways (4.6 mi); P8 at LTS 3.5: 1 way (0.6 mi). P4 and P8 are two-lane Fairfax County streets VDOT's speed limit records post at 35 mph that OpenStreetMap carries no speed for; a way along several count blocks takes the busiest. P3 and P6 (county-posted 25 mph streets) were withdrawn the same day by the owner ("Let the formula decide") once Virginia's urban default became 25 mph. Left out: ways the reviewed blocks cover less than half of; P4 and P8 ways OSM tags with a speed limit (the mapped sign is not overruled here), one-way, or with other than two lanes; and points where the road panel found an unnamed or differently named way, another rating than the review saw, or a bike lane. R2 (Arlington's calmest uncounted residential streets at LTS 1.5) is held back: it rests on Arlington's Bike Comfort Index, which has no licence yet. Only ways VDOT's own speed limit layer confirms at 35 mph are kept (the v0.16.0 scope review): Fairfax County's layer, which first showed the 35, is all rights reserved, and on 16 of its 71 ways VDOT records 25 or 30 mph.

rows.reason: The owner, 2026-10-31, approving the Virginia ratings recheck: "Let's go with all these". P4: a two-lane Fairfax County street posted at 35 mph (VDOT's speed limit records), counted above 1,500 a day, was rated LTS 3 because OpenStreetMap carries no speed limit for it and the formula read a lower default. The formula with the posted 35 gives LTS 4 (35 mph mixed traffic, no low-volume relief above 1,500); on the streets where Fairfax County's bike map and this classifier agree, such streets sit between LTS 3 and LTS 4. So LTS 3.5 below 5,000 a day and LTS 4 from 5,000; a way along several count blocks takes the busiest. Kept as an owner row: the build does not yet read VDOT's speed limit layer.
